question: The festival of Makar Sankranti is devoted to which of the following gods?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Surya.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Makar Sankranti** is a Hindu festival that is celebrated across** India, Nepal and Bangladesh.**
 
• It is also known as **Uttarayan **and is dedicated to the **Sun God, Surya.**
 
• The festival is observed on **January 14th** every year and marks the transition of the Sun from the **Tropic of Cancer to the Tropic of Capricorn.**
 
• During this time, people take holy dips in rivers, offer prayers to the Sun God and indulge in traditional foods like** tilgul, laddoo and khichdi.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vishnu** is a **Hindu God** who is also widely worshipped in India. 
 
• **Indra** is a deity associated with **thunder and rain** and is not connected with Makar Sankranti.
 
• **Shiva** is one of the **principal deities** in Hinduism.
